purpose: Proposed matched text-only evaluation of the pinned upstream BALROG naive agent on 255 fixed cases across all six environments. No real-model parity has run; this document is not permission to spend.

coordination.claim: Claimed by contributor; parity plan not yet confirmed
coordination.request_now: Request maintainer decisions on scope, oracle/scoring exceptions, platform, exact model, staged quotas and standard CLI-agent coverage; request credentials through a private channel. No credential or quota provision is claimed.
before_paid_runs: Written agreement on this exact scope, model snapshot, agent revisions, native settings and staged cost/token/runtime limits.

Resolve or explicitly accept the remaining NLE/MiniHack reference limitations, the Crafter privileged-reference proposal and the existing Crafter replay/scoring exception before claiming the oracle gate is met.
Provision 2077ai and Daytona credentials privately; confirm exact dated model availability, account permissions and request/token quotas. Provisioning is not spending authorization.
Finish explicit sanity task-ID selection and validate launchers against the chosen Harbor revision; freeze adapter/runtime/image/settings/manifests and test both sides without paid calls.
Validate the original game sidecar, collect hook and separate verifier on the approved platform; current evidence is local Docker, not Daytona.
Approve paired sanity spending first. Estimate subsequent usage from retained sanity accounting and approve each scale-up before launching it.
coordination.delivery_scope: All six environments together in one adapter PR, as confirmed by the contributor.

scope.selection: Every configured task type at predetermined seeds; identical cases on both sides; never filter by oracle or model success.
scope.sanity: Ten predetermined seed-0 cases span all six environments and several interaction families. Selection is based on coverage, not observed success. Sanity executions are excluded from formal statistics.
scope.manifest_policy: Hashes below bind the current original 255-case scope. Any approved source, scorer, native-budget or scope change requires new manifests, validation and a revised approved experiment; do not silently exclude the six unresolved NLE/MiniHack cases or promote private Crafter references.
scope.sanity_previous_split: The existing --split sanity selects all 58 seed-0 task types. It is not the proposed initial paid stage; keep it available for offline checks. Explicit selection support is required before the ten-task stage.

primary_experiment.harbor_agent: balrog-native bridge reusing the same pinned upstream naive implementation
primary_experiment.selection_reason: Dated model used in the pinned upstream README example; fits the native max_tokens/temperature Chat Completions client without changing agent behavior.
primary_experiment.provider_availability: Unconfirmed. This previously selected dated model is a proposal; no alias/model substitution without revising and confirming the plan.
primary_experiment.model_sampling_seed: Not supplied by upstream client; environment seeds fixed separately.
primary_experiment.timeout_caveat: Upstream timeout=60 is not forwarded to the SDK; only the outer 1800-second episode timeout is enforced. Pin identical SDK and effective request behavior.
equivalence: Same prompts, observations, action parsing, invalid-action handling and native scoring
Same model settings, source snapshots, runtime dependencies and limits
Fresh agent history and environment for every episode
Preserve raw trajectories, request metadata, usage, returned model IDs and configuration hashes; redact secrets
primary_experiment.outer_timeout_policy: Initial infrastructure deadline on both sides, not a new native task limit. Timeout is an infrastructure failure, never a scored zero or accepted incomplete run. Longer settings, particularly NLE/Crafter, may be agreed after sanity and must match both sides for formal runs.
primary_experiment.harbor_revision_policy: 0.26.0 is the version used for completed local separate-verifier reference validation. Recheck upstream before paid runs, agree and freeze the actual release/commit, and repeat preflight after a version change.
primary_experiment.adapter_revision_policy: Freeze the reviewed PR commit plus generated task, runner and image digests before each experiment revision; the current proposal does not certify an uncommitted checkout as a final execution pin.

implementation_status.native: Implemented via the original Evaluator.run_episode with transparent recorders.
implementation_status.harbor: Implemented as balrog.agent:BalrogNativeAgent using the same pinned upstream naive agent through public HTTP observations/actions.
implementation_status.real_model_validation: Not run; offline fake-client and reference validation are separate evidence.
preflight_gaps: Both public launchers currently select the entire seed-0 sanity split; add audited explicit task-ID selection without changing fixtures or task budgets.
Validate/update scripts/run_harbor.py for the agreed Harbor JobConfig, including top-level n_concurrent_trials instead of relying on the old orchestrator object.
Record and compare actual prompts, effective settings, launch configuration and request behavior on both sides before scaling.

primary_experiment.nle_native_no_progress_timeout_meaning: 150 native calls without a game-clock advance; not 150 elapsed game turns and not a reward-progress timeout.

execution.formal_platform_proposed: Daytona on both sides, as requested by the team, after validating identical pinned assets, game-sidecar isolation, collection and separate verification.
execution.current_platform: Local Linux Docker containers with Docker Compose; Daytona not yet validated.
execution.preflight: Verify all 255 original references and representative wrong-action controls on the selected platform; preserve partial scores and secure artifact transfer. The existing 239 full-score plus 16 diagnostic baseline does not by itself satisfy the guide's 100% oracle gate.
execution.fallback: If the required sidecar/collect/separate-verifier topology cannot be supported on Daytona, document the blocker and obtain maintainer approval for an alternative. Local Docker evidence is not Daytona validation; do not mix platforms within a comparison.

stages.name: paired_sanity
stages.approval_gate: Approve exact selection and a finite sanity cost/token/runtime cap first.

stages.name: first_full_pair
stages.approval_gate: Both sanity sides complete, errors diagnosed, settings frozen and first full-pair budget approved.

stages.name: two_additional_full_pairs
stages.approval_gate: One complete full run on each side reviewed before scaling. Execute paired repeats 2 and 3; never finish three on one side first.

stopping_rules: Validate requests, usage, resets and scoring on both sides before scaling beyond sanity
Pause on API/quota/simulator/verifier/transport errors; retain them as infrastructure failures, not score zero
Investigate systematic divergence; if both full runs are all zero, report weak/no discriminating evidence and agree a stronger-model diagnostic rather than declaring parity from range overlap alone
Do not select tasks or add runs until overlap appears; obtain agreement for changes and preserve all attempts
After evaluation fixes, freeze corrected inputs and restart the affected paired comparison; never pool incompatible runs
execution.retry_policy: Preserve every API retry, failed attempt and original artifact. Genuine agent failures remain native scores. Infrastructure failures invalidate completion, never become synthetic zeros; replacements require a recorded cause and an agreed retry allowance, not selection of the better outcome.

supplementary_standard_agent.proposal: Use one existing Harbor standard CLI agent (Codex or Claude-Code) with a team-selected pinned version/model to exercise the public balrog-task interface. Select task coverage, repetition count and budget separately with maintainers.
supplementary_standard_agent.implementation_boundary: Harbor supplies these standard agents; no new CLI-agent implementation is claimed. This adapter has no validated pinned CLI-agent experiment/config/results yet. Confirm whether the existing generated task instructions suffice or a separate compatibility dataset is required.
supplementary_standard_agent.primary_comparison: This is supplementary generalization evidence and does not replace matched upstream naive-agent parity. Its counts and costs are not included in the 1550 primary proposed episodes.

statistics.full_run_score: Compute each environment mean over its complete frozen scope, then take the equally weighted mean of six environment means. Do not use the flat 255-episode mean.
statistics.report: Mean +/- sample SEM across three full repeats, separately for original and Harbor, for each environment and the equal-weight six-environment score.
statistics.diagnostics: Keep run arrays, per-type and per-episode results, actions, usage and failure classification. Range overlap is the repository criterion, not proof of statistical equivalence.
statistics.limitation: Repeated runs estimate model variability on the fixed selected seeds, not population uncertainty across all possible worlds.
statistics.excluded: Sanity executions and scripted mock-API artifacts never enter formal run arrays.
statistics.after_first_pair: Report the two single-run scores and per-case diagnostics without SEM; sample SEM is undefined with one run per side.
statistics.range_overlap_scope: Check and publish raw run-score ranges for each environment and the equal-weight aggregate; aggregate overlap must not hide a systematic environment-level mismatch.

resources.ceiling_note: Sum of unchanged native action budgets across proposed executions, assuming the naive agent's one completion per action. This is not expected usage, a provider-request ceiling including retries, or spending authorization. NLE dominates; retain its original budget unless a revised experiment is approved.
resources.stage_limits: Pending maintainer approval, separately for sanity, first full pair, two additional pairs, and the supplementary CLI agent. Initial concurrency is 1; increase only with explicit quota/concurrency agreement.
resources.budget: No price or dollar forecast is assumed. Confirm current provider billing and quota, measure sanity usage including retries, then estimate and approve each later stage. Stop before the approved cap; an interrupted run is not a complete formal result.
resources.credentials: Request 2077ai inference and Daytona access through an agreed private secret channel. Store credentials in ignored environment files or a secret store, never in this proposal, PR comments, logs or artifacts.

deliverables: README with exact scope, pins, commands and mean +/- sample SEM
parity_experiment.json populated only from complete real-model results and authentic publication links
Raw native and Harbor trajectories/settings/usage/provenance uploaded to the agreed parity dataset
Reproducible original-benchmark fork and task-dataset publication as required
Coverage and limitations for all six environments, including preserved upstream scoring issues.

existing_evidence.reference_validation: Harbor 0.26.0 separate-verifier run completed all 255 original references: 239 full-score oracles, 16 diagnostics, zero exceptions, 255 exact fresh replays, original scores unchanged. See docs/separate_verifier_full_validation.md; not model parity.
existing_evidence.offline_integration: Scripted fake HTTP/API tests only; excluded from formal analysis.
existing_evidence.crafter_v45: Separately evaluated privileged reference-controller proposal; see docs/crafter_v45_validation.md. Maintainer acceptance and promotion remain pending. It does not change this plan's original manifest hashes, baseline oracle counts or model inputs; native object-order replay limitations still apply.

maintainer_decisions.question: Approve all 255 original fixed cases and matched upstream naive/balrog-native primary agents, with ten-task paired sanity then 1 then 3 full runs per side?

Accept explicitly partial references under the original scorer, whose reachable-key ceiling is 0.8067964442444019, or require a separately proposed native ascension-event scorer correction pinned identically on both sides? No correction or normalization is applied.

Keep the original 100-action scope with its documented unsolved case, or approve a new upstream-compatible 200-action Boxoban revision on both sides? The separate 40/40 proposal is not current baseline evidence.

Accept the V45 privileged read-only reference-controller approach as oracle evidence, and separately approve the explicit trusted-native-state grading fallback for upstream object-order replay nondeterminism? Neither gives model agents private state, and neither is yet accepted.

Is gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 available through 2077ai at https://app.ppapi.ai/v1 with the proposed settings? If not, agree an exact dated replacement before changing settings. Which private credential-provisioning channel and account quotas should be used?

Confirm Daytona provisioning and the required sidecar/collect/separate-verifier topology, plus finite per-stage cost/token/runtime caps, request/token rate quotas, concurrency and retry allowances before any paid request. Approve any alternative platform separately if a demonstrated blocker arises.
Which pinned standard CLI agent/model, task scope, repeats and separate budget satisfy Scenario 3, and is a separate compatibility dataset needed?
